column10: The classic post handler ran for every front-end request without a nonce check and kept the logged-in user: a cross-site form post could act as that user (store their user id and pass logged-in rules).
column11: Logged-in visitors send the REST nonce with the classic post; a missing or wrong nonce runs the post as a guest (wp_set_current_user 0). Guests still need no nonce so cached pages keep working.
